data.name: Doris
data.gender_notes: Doris is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Doris was a sea goddess. In the Bible, there is no character named Doris. However, the name is derived from the Greek word for ‘dew,’ symbolizing new beginnings and fresh starts. The name Doris carries the meaning “Dew, Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Doris usually hope their child will grow to embody dew, gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the divine blessings of new life and renewal.
data.etymology: Doris belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dew, Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Doris total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
